description:
## Summary
- Add a custom "Blacksmith's Forge" CSS theme for the DocFX documentation site
- Warm amber/ember tones against dark steel surfaces reflecting ForgeMap's compile-time code generation identity
- Custom typography: Outfit (headings), DM Sans (body), IBM Plex Mono (code)
- Full light/dark mode support with smooth transitions
- Fix theme toggle button visibility on dark navbar

## Test plan
- [ ] Run `docfx docfx/docfx.json && docfx serve docfx/_site --port 8080` and verify theme renders correctly
- [ ] Verify light and dark mode toggle works and both themes look good
- [ ] Verify theme toggle button is visible on the dark navbar
- [ ] Check landing page gradient title, code blocks, tables, and sidebar styling
